title: Slow phone performance
description: It will improve speed and responsiveness.
text: When the Galaxy phone becomes slow or laggy after an update, open Settings, then Battery and device care. Tap Optimize now to close background apps and improve device performance.
steps: Open Settings on the Galaxy phone.
Tap Optimize now to improve performance.

title: Swipe navigation settings
description: It will let you choose navigation type.
text: For swipe navigation behaving incorrectly after an app install, open Settings, tap Display, then Navigation bar. Select Buttons or Swipe gestures and optionally enable Gesture hint.
steps: Open Settings on the Galaxy phone.

title: Battery fast drain
description: It will identify apps using excess power.
text: When battery drains quickly, open Settings, then Battery and device care, then Battery. Review the usage graph and app list to identify apps using excess power.
steps: Open Settings on the Galaxy phone.
Review apps using excess battery power.

title: Blurry camera photos
description: It will restore standard camera configuration.
text: If camera photos remain blurry, open Camera, tap Settings, then Reset settings. Confirm Reset to restore the default camera configuration.

title: Screen flicker settings
description: It will stabilize the screen refresh rate.
text: If the screen flickers, open Settings, tap Display, then Motion smoothness. Select Standard and tap Apply to stabilize the refresh rate.
steps: Open Settings on the Galaxy phone.
